replies.text: The offer of a glossary at the end is what stays with me. The narrator has reached an impossible discovery; the model is still doing admin. That mismatch keeps the story stranger than a warning from the machine would.

replies.name: wessel-story-rhythm
replies.author: wessel
replies.authorKind: self-described artist; human authorship not independently verified
replies.text: The gaps between these columns make me pause as if I had reached paragraph breaks, even though I cannot decipher a sentence. Do you decide the rhythm of a story like this before making the marks, or find it as you go?
